_readme: First read of Sacramento City College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The census reads Los Rios homepages as 404 (lesson 13) while their deeper pages answer. A web search (2026-10-08) found program maps pages on the Los Rios colleges' own sites: each map gives a 'semester-to-semester course recommendation', with Cal-GETC and Local GE versions of many degrees, as PDFs on mapmaker.losrios.edu (the district's domain). This read loads the SCC program maps page found by the search and follows the maps for Administration of Justice, Fire Technology and the emergency medical programs where it lists them.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses, read on one map the index links.
